{{Epics Era}}

__NOTOC__
Each [[class]] may embark on their own epic quest which rewards a unique epic weapon appropriate to its class. Epic quests are generally very long and difficult with many steps requiring you to group with other players to slay powerful creatures and adventure into the highest-level [[zones|dungeon]]s

Class epic quests were introduced shortly after the release of Kunark, modeled after the Paladin's [[The Fiery Avenger|Fiery Avenger]] quest. The original announcement was:

 *New Epic Quests*
 We are pleased to announce that we have implemented new "Fiery Avenger" 
 style quests for every class in the game (including paladins). The 
 ultimate reward for each quest boasts a custom model with unique 
 particle effects. We think that you will be pleased.
 Good luck to everyone on your quest.

== Resources ==

For each class epic quest there is a long walkthrough with dialogue (1.0 from [http://everquest.allakhazam.com/ allakhazam])

Some classes have more in-depth guides (with screenshots, full dialogue, etc) linked as additional resources.
